question: KRAV is related to GNWR in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, UBKF is related to QXGB. To which of the following is IPYT related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**For KRAV to GNWR**

 
 
 
 

 K(11)
 R(18)
 A(1)
 V(22)

 R(18)
 
 

**For UBKF to QXGB**

 ↓ -4
 ↓ -4
 ↓ -4
 ↓ -4
 
 

 Q(17)

**For IPYT:**

 
 
 
 

 I(9)
 P(16)
 Y(25)
 T(20)
 
 

 ↓ -4

 ↓ -4
 ↓ -4
 
 

 E(5)

 U(21)
 P(16)
 
 

Thus, IPYT is related to ELUP.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
